scale_cues: Large square white dinner plate (about 26-28 cm) as the main reference. Cauliflower florets are about 4-6 cm across and potato cubes about 2.5-3 cm, which helps estimate volume. No cutlery or hand is in the frame.
assumptions: The steak is a lean cut like sirloin or tri-tip, cooked medium
The light-colored meat at the top is skinless chicken breast, not pork or fish
The cauliflower has no butter or sauce, only a little oil carried over
The potatoes were roasted in roughly 5 g of oil and about 3 g of fat was used on the meats
The pale green pieces among the cauliflower are leek or cabbage
The image shows the whole dish and nothing is hidden underneath
